name: Sanquan Food Co., Ltd.
summary: Sanquan Food Co., Ltd. produces and sells frozen food products in China. The company offers frozen and refrigerated rice and noodle products, such as dumplings, glutinous rice balls, noodles, wonton, zongzi, and snacks. It also provides frozen and refrigerated prepared food, including grilled sausages, meat rolls, hot pot meatballs, other hot pot ingredients, pre-prepared ingredients, and pre-cooked dishes. The company sells its products through online and offline channels.
